capabilities: Sync vault files bidirectionally with a Google Drive folder
Push and pull changes via commands, ribbon button, or automatic push
Resolve conflicts automatically with local file prioritization
Sync multiple vaults per Google account by vault name
Sync Obsidian configuration files between devices
disambiguation: Unofficial and independent from Obsidian's own Sync service; it stores vault files in the user's Google Drive.
extras: The README strongly warns to always back up the vault, forbids manual edits to the synced Google Drive folder or files outside Obsidian, states there is no manual conflict resolution, and notes vault contents pass between the device and the Google Drive API with a privacy policy provided; setup instructions with images live on the plugin's homepage.
intentEvidence: This is not the official sync service provided by Obsidian
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through a user's own Google Drive account, including on iOS.

relations.evidence: This plugin communicates with external servers, namely the Google Drive API

summary: Unofficial sync plugin that keeps an Obsidian vault synchronized with a Google Drive folder across devices, including the iOS app.
